title: Saudi Arabian Prawns in Ceviche Style
description: A refreshing and flavorful dish inspired by the cuisine of Saudi Arabia, featuring succulent prawns marinated in a zesty ceviche mixture.
instructions: 1. Rinse the prawns under cold water and pat them dry with paper towels.
2. In a large bowl, combine the chopped king prawns, garlic, ginger, and cilantro.
3. Squeeze the lime juice over the mixture and toss to coat.
4. Add the ceviche and stir to combine.
5. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
6. Just before serving, add the ultra juicy prawns to the bowl and toss to combine.
7. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
8. Serve the prawns chilled, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
